OpenRouter gives you one API for every AI model that routes and governs every request, so your AI is better, faster, and cheaper. Try it free: https://openrouter.ai/?utm_source=fireship&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=2026-11_dev-sponsorships&utm_content=description

Microsoft took down Exchange Online for roughly 36 hours with a routine network capacity upgrade, so let’s break down what actually failed, why turning it off and on again didn’t work, and whether it had anything to do with the FAA grounding every flight in America.

snippet.description:
The country’s biggest AI companies have a security problem. Nvidia’s former CEO Jensen Huang was having an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy. An OpenAI employee allegedly bugged a conference room where sensitive conversations take place. Vox’s Sigal Samuel explains why security is especially important when it comes to AI.
